title: tragacantha lateritia
intro: Tragacantha lateritia, commonly known as the lesser burnet or burnet-saxifrage, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha lateritia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that work together to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-oxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Tragacantha lateritia also possess analgesic and anti-ulcerative properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
